string-array.name: novidades
string-array.item: Phone app: it asks for the camera before opening the QR reader; if you say no, it offers Try again or the phone\'s settings, in the phone\'s language
Help other homes: “See what goes today” shows each server address as it reads, without backslashes
Panel: turning the phone microphone or camera off also clears the “Microphone on” or “Live on the TV” notice
Air quality: “Hazardous” is shown in alert red
Test channel: updates come in parts, so the TV downloads less, and the home screen frees graphics memory while another app is open or the screen is off

string-array.name: roteiro_perguntas
string-array.item: In the phone app, tap Read the TV\'s QR code and answer Don\'t allow to the camera question: does the app offer Try again, in the phone\'s language?
Open Help other homes › See what goes today: do the addresses read like https://api.sofaly.tv/v1/…, without backslashes?
In the panel on the phone, turn the microphone on and then off: does the “Microphone on” notice go away?
With a film open, turn subtitles on, change the subtitle delay and, in Settings, a player setting; reopen the film: did both stick?
